items.summaryOriginal: STORY: U.S. stocks closed mostly higher on Wednesday, with the Dow the only outlier, ending virtually flat, the S&P 500 gaining about a quarter of a percent, and the Nasdaq adding more than half a percent. :: CoreWeave Upbeat quarterly results from AI-related firms continued to soothe investor fears about massive capex spending. :: CoreWeave Shares of CoreWeave, for instance, surged 19% after the AI cloud company lifted its annual capital spending forecast and topped second-quarter earnings estimates. So some of these same companies and sub-industries within the AI complex that sold off hard are bouncing dramatically. And chip makers gained, with Nvidia rising 3% and Micron Technology adding about 5%.  Meanwhile, data on Wednesday showed U.S. consumer prices barely increased in July as the cost of gasoline declined for a second straight month, further reducing expectations of an interest rate hike next month from the Federal Reserve.
